provenance.purpose: Independent witness for allene SMILES marks. Labels written by Centres, not by TCKDB.
provenance.mapping: M is Ra, P is Sa (IUPAC; the sign of the torsion between the two CIP-higher substituents).

centres.used_for: reading the marks and labelling the axis

provenance.command: python backend/scripts/dev/generate_allene_marks_witness.py --cdk-jar cdk-2.13.jar --centres-jar centres-1.2.1.jar   (labels: java -jar centres-1.2.1.jar <file.smi>; respellings: 12 random atom and bond orders per molecule and mark, fixed seeds 1000..)

via_values.direct: Centres labelled the SMILES in the row.
via_values.cdk-canonical-roundtrip: Centres labels nothing for this text (a ring digit on the central atom, though other texts with one are labelled directly); the label is that of CDK's canonical re-export, given in roundtrip_smiles.
